# Get File Link

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Gets the iCloud link to a certain file.

## Syntax

~~~~text
getFileLink(file: <#Variable#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
getFileLink(file: ShortcutInput)
~~~~
